CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Christian Moral Values: Purity? (1 mark)
   A. Use Christian Moral Values: Purity to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Christian Moral Values: Purity with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Christian Moral Values: Purity.
   D. Say Christian Moral Values: Purity has no place in daily life.
